package fx

import "fmt"

// Chain is exported.
func Chain(a, b int) (int, error) {
	if a > 0 {
		return 1, nil
	} else if b > 0 {
		fmt.Println("b")
	} else if a == b {
	} else {
		return 3, nil
	}
	if x := a; x < 0 {
	} else {
	}
	if a > 1 {
		a++
		return a, nil
	} /* c */ else {
		b--
	}
L:
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		if i == 2 {
			continue L
		} else {
			break
		}
	}
	switch v := a; v {
	case 1:
		return 1, nil
	case 2:
	default:
		if b > 0 {
			return 2, nil
		} else {
			goto M
		}
	}
M:
	return 0, nil
}

// Lits is exported so its statement forms enter the DS projection.
func Lits(ch chan int, xs []string) func() int {
	var s string = "héllo, 世界"
	go func() { ch <- 1 }()
	defer func() {}()
	;
	{
		ch <- 0
	}
B:
	{
		s += "!"
	}
	for _, x := range xs {
		f := func() int {
			g := func() int {
				if len(x) > 0 {
					return 1
				} else {
					return 2
				}
			}
			return g()
		}
		_ = f
	}
	if f := func() bool { return s != "" }; f() {
		return func() int { return 1 }
	} else {
		ch <- 2
	}
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		if v > 0 {
			return nil
		} else {
		}
	case ch <- 3:
	default:
	}
	var t interface{} = s
	switch u := t.(type) {
	case string:
		_ = u
	}
	switch n := len(s); n {
	case 1:n++
	case 2:
	N:
	}
	return nil
}

// Größe has Unicode identifiers.
func Größe(ä int) int {
	if ä > 0 {
	E:
	} else {
		ä--
	}
	return ä
}
